QuestInfo.name: [Kritias] Missing History
QuestInfo.1: Hirrel asked you to deliver his copy of #bKritias History#k to Ereve. #bNeinheart#k will want to see this.
QuestInfo.2: You delivered the Kritias History to Neinheart.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary:
#Wbasic#
#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0#  28,953,613
Can proceed to [Kritias] Gap in Time

0.0: I've checked my facts and configurated my figures, and I've come to one conclusion: You are from the future.\r\nOR, and hear me out here: The Black Mage froze you in time.\r\n
0.1: I think I would've noted such an event. In either case, if the outside world has forgotten us, then I'm sure there are many things about the outside world that are missing from my records!
0.2: I have a humble request. I want you to deliver this copy of Kritias History to Ereve. I want to know what we've missed, so in exchange, I hope to receive a history of Maple World from the outside.
0.3: Here is #b#t4033935##k. I hope you succeed. I do hate a gap in the record.\r\n#b(*If you accept, you'll travel there immediately.)#k

1.0: Have you visited the mysterious kingdom?

yes.0: Intriguing. It doesn't look so old, but the contents of this book are hundreds of years out of date.

npc.0: Please deliver the Kritias History to Ereve. Surely they must have someone as meticulous as I. Perhaps they can help us find out how long Kritias has been frozen in time.

item.0: It would appear your visit was less than fruitful.
